records.scope: Entire javap outputs displayed for CategoryTimeBox and all five companions; no original execution.
records.observation: Extends TimeBoundingBox. Both constructors call superclass no-arg; default stores null weight, parameter constructor stores supplied CategoryWeightF reference with no copy or checks. getCategoryRatio(boolean) delegates weight.getRatio; color delegates weight.getCategory().getColor and visibility delegates Category.isVisiblySearchable. getCategoryWeightF and synthetic access$400 return same weight reference. No setter or validity enforcement; default/null weight causes getter dereferences to fail, unresolved category also affects color/visibility. No own serialization or time-derived ratio computation; inherited mutable time bounds independent of delegated weight. Static initializer creates singleton Index/InclRatio/ExclRatio/Count comparator objects through synthetic constructor parameter null. Confirms SummaryState visibility decision is Category delegation, not a new local filter; TimeAveBox array selection remains separate.
